description: Implementation of RendererController class managing media remoting, sink capabilities, and media state transitions in Chromium's remoting module.

classes.name: RendererController
classes.description: Controls media remoting sessions, manages sink capabilities, and handles media state transitions.

methods.name: OnSinkAvailable
methods.description: Handles availability of a remoting sink and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: OnSinkGone
methods.description: Handles sink removal and prevents future remoting sessions.

methods.name: OnStarted
methods.description: Handles successful start of remoting session.

methods.name: OnStartFailed
methods.description: Handles failure to start remoting session.

methods.name: OnStopped
methods.description: Handles stopping of remoting session.

methods.name: OnMessageFromSink
methods.description: Processes messages received from the sink.

methods.name: OnBecameDominantVisibleContent
methods.description: Updates state when media becomes the dominant visible content.

methods.name: OnRemotePlaybackDisabled
methods.description: Handles remote playback being disabled.

methods.name: OnMediaRemotingRequested
methods.description: Handles explicit request to start media remoting.

methods.name: StartDataPipe
methods.description: Establishes data pipes for audio/video streams.

methods.name: OnMetadataChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in media pipeline metadata.

methods.name: OnDataSourceInitialized
methods.description: Handles initialization of data source URL.

methods.name: OnHlsManifestDetected
methods.description: Handles detection of HLS manifest (Android only).

methods.name: UpdateRemotePlaybackAvailabilityMonitoringState
methods.description: Updates support state for remote playback based on current media and URL.

methods.name: IsVideoCodecSupported
methods.description: Checks if current video codec is supported for remoting.

methods.name: IsAudioCodecSupported
methods.description: Checks if current audio codec is supported for remoting.

methods.name: GetVideoCompatibility
methods.description: Determines if video is compatible for remoting based on codec and encryption.

methods.name: GetAudioCompatibility
methods.description: Determines if audio is compatible for remoting based on codec and encryption.

methods.name: GetCompatibility
methods.description: Assesses overall remoting compatibility based on current media state.

methods.name: IsAudioOrVideoSupported
methods.description: Checks if current media codecs are supported for remoting.

methods.name: UpdateAndMaybeSwitch
methods.description: Decides whether to start or stop remoting based on current state and triggers.

methods.name: OnRendererFatalError
methods.description: Handles fatal errors during remoting session.

methods.name: SetClient
methods.description: Assigns or clears the media observer client.

methods.name: HasVideoCapability
methods.description: Checks if sink supports specific video capabilities.

methods.name: HasAudioCapability
methods.description: Checks if sink supports specific audio capabilities.

methods.name: HasFeatureCapability
methods.description: Checks if sink supports specific features.

methods.name: SinkSupportsRemoting
methods.description: Determines if current sink supports remoting.

methods.name: ShouldBeRemoting
methods.description: Decides if remoting should be active based on media state and capabilities.

methods.name: MaybeStartCalculatePixelRateTimer
methods.description: Initiates pixel rate calculation timer if conditions are met.

methods.name: DoCalculatePixelRate
methods.description: Calculates pixel rate based on decoded frames and elapsed time.

methods.name: GetPixelRateSupport
methods.description: Returns support level for current pixel rate.

methods.name: SendMessageToSink
methods.description: Sends a message to the sink.

methods.name: IsAudioRemotePlaybackSupported
methods.description: Checks if current audio configuration supports remote playback (Android only).

methods.name: IsVideoRemotePlaybackSupported
methods.description: Checks if current video configuration supports remote playback (Android only).

methods.name: IsRemotePlaybackSupported
methods.description: Checks if current media supports remote playback (Android only).
